newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards May 17-19 naphtha to Stinnes Hamburg.
newsitem.headline: India awards May 17-19 naphtha to Stinnes Hamburg.

text.p: State-owned Indian oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to sell 28,000 tonnes of May low aromatic naphtha (LAN) to German trader Stinnes, industry sources said on Thursday.
The May 17-19 cargo, loading from Bombay was awarded to Stinnes in Hamburg at $53 per tonne below U.S Gulf coast 87-octane gasoline spot waterbourne quotes, sources said.
Traders said the awarded price is equivalent to $25-$30 per tonne discount to Japanese spot naphtha quotes free-on-board Bombay basis.
The tender, previously scheduled to close May 9 was postponed to close on May 14, due to poor response.
In its last tender IOC sold 30,000 tonnes of HAN at a record low price of $40 a tonne below Japanese spot quotes for May 6-7 lifting free-on-board Cochin.
